title: Outline
description: White-filled, full-pill button with an accent-blue border and text, matching a trailing arrow icon like the Secondary button. Fills to accent-300 on hover.

styles.css: &::after { content: "\2192"; margin-inline-start: var(--wp--preset--spacing--5); } &:hover { background-color: var(--wp--preset--color--accent-300); border-color: var(--wp--preset--color--neutral-200); color: var(--wp--preset--color--neutral-200); }
